title: Pick the theme and accent in two hero rows on the 12-minute builder, remember the last pick, and mirror the typed name in the preview

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-13: the theme step of /create-a-space is confusing; one row of theme buttons, one of accents, same hero; New World unless they came from another theme; remember the last pick; preview says Business Name.

detail: Theme and accent are two radiogroups in the hero (create-space-look.tsx) instead of a Change theme link plus swatches inside the name card. Nothing blocks Next on an accent now. A pick writes the fq_last_kit cookie and a new fq_last_accent cookie; the next visit starts on them unless the address names a kit. The preview name reads Business Name until a name is typed. Done when scripts/probes/create-space-look-row.mjs passes.
